submission.justification:
Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap is the optimal configuration that satisfies all project constraints while achieving the best possible time resolution of 1.938 ns.

ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE: Mixture-G2 is the only candidate mixture that meets the hard GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement mandated by the laboratory's environmental policy. Mixtures G1 and G3, despite offering superior time resolution performance (1.3 ns and 0.9 ns respectively at 2 mm gap), contain fluorinated gases with GWP100 values far exceeding 150 and were necessarily excluded from consideration.

PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION: Systematic simulation across the full allowed gas gap range (1.0-3.0 mm) identified 2.0 mm as the optimal operating point for Mixture-G2. The performance curve shows a clear minimum at this gap (1.938 ns), with symmetric degradation toward both smaller gaps (2.302 ns at 1.0 mm) and larger gaps (2.213 ns at 3.0 mm). This represents a 15.8% improvement over the worst-case gap configuration.

ROBUST DESIGN: The 2.0 mm gap represents a well-defined performance optimum with balanced physical characteristics - optimal avalanche development without excessive drift time or diffusion effects. This gap is also mechanically feasible and represents standard RPC construction practice.

IMPLEMENTATION READINESS: All supporting infrastructure is verified compatible - the mixture is available from suppliers, the HV system supports required voltages up to 12 kV, and the planned gas recirculation system (90% recovery) will minimize operational costs and environmental impact.

This recommendation represents the best achievable detector performance while maintaining strict adherence to environmental responsibility requirements.
